# Focused kernel-soundness profile

Perform a narrow second-pass review of trusted checking, substitution,
weakening, conversion, normalization, universe computation, and declaration
sequencing. Keep the base prompt's trust rules, severity definitions,
foundational firewall, and JSON output contract unchanged.

Trace binder depth and cutoffs explicitly. Check shifted context lookup,
capture avoidance, motive decomposition, transparency, neutral forms,
termination assumptions, and the accepted/rejected conformance boundary.
Construct the smallest judgment or declaration sequence that would expose each
suspected error. Do not propose a stronger or different theory as a code fix;
route any such remedy through `foundational_stop`.
